RAINWORLD-WorkLevel_description:
When you take [red]fatal damage[/red], if your [gold]Karma[/gold] is not [blue]1[/blue], [gold]Rebirth[/gold] and lose [red]1[/red] [gold]Karma[/gold].
Your Max HP gain efficiency is reduced to 1/5, and you can lose at most 1 Max HP at a time.
Current [gold]Karma[/gold]: [blue]{work_level}[/blue]/[blue]{max_work_level}[/blue]
RAINWORLD-Food_description: In combat, you can spend [gold]Fullness[/gold] to perform [gold]Hibernate[/gold].
RAINWORLD-Food_Liver_description:
Diet: [gold]Omnivorous[/gold]
After completing a normal [gold]Monster[/gold]/[gold]Elite[/gold]/[gold]Boss[/gold] combat, gain [blue]3[/blue]/[blue]5[/blue]/[blue]7[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold]. Entering a non-combat room grants [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold].
RAINWORLD-Food_River_description:
Diet: [gold]Omnivorous[/gold]
After completing a normal [gold]Monster[/gold]/[gold]Elite[/gold]/[gold]Boss[/gold] combat, gain [blue]3[/blue]/[blue]5[/blue]/[blue]6[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold]. Entering a non-combat room grants [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold].
RAINWORLD-Food_RedCat_description:
Diet: [red]Carnivorous[/red]
After completing a normal [gold]Monster[/gold]/[gold]Elite[/gold]/[gold]Boss[/gold] combat, gain [blue]5[/blue]/[blue]7[/blue]/[blue]9[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold].
RAINWORLD-Sleep_description:
Click this button to spend [gold]Fullness[/gold] to perform [gold]Hibernate[/gold].
End your current turn. If you take no damage until the start of your next turn, gain 1 [gold]Karma[/gold].
If your [gold]Karma[/gold] is already full, gain 1 [gold]Karma Lock[/gold] instead.
Set all mod monsters above to Always / Slugcat only / Disabled at once. 'Always' follows each monster's individual setting.

RAINWORLD-config.title: SlugcatTheSpireII
RAINWORLD-config.enableCombatCantLossMax: Prevent losing Max HP during combat.
Attacks from Bright Flame and Biting Scroll no longer cause Slugcat characters to lose Max HP. [Not recommended]
RAINWORLD-config.enableMaxHpCantUsedReli: Disable vanilla relics that have no effect on Slugcat.
RAINWORLD-config.enableMaxHpRelicFix: Disable vanilla Max HP related relics.
RAINWORLD-config.enableMaxHpRelicFix.des: Affected relics: Mango, Pear, Strawberry, Dragon Fruit, Darkstone Periapt.
RAINWORLD-config.enableHpRelicFix: Disable vanilla HP recovery related relics.
RAINWORLD-config.enableHpRelicFix.desc: Affected relics: Blood Vial, Book of Five Rings, Eternal Feather, Lee's Waffle, Meal Ticket, Meat on the Bone, Pantograph, Regal Pillow, Planisphere.
RAINWORLD-config.enableExcludeSlugcatFro: Exclude Slugcat cards when other characters search other character cards.
When enabled, non-Slugcat characters using mechanisms that search other character cards (Splash, Prismatic Gem, Colorful Philosophers, etc.) will not include Slugcat cards.
RAINWORLD-config.hpEventFix: Disable vanilla HP recovery related events.
RAINWORLD-config.slugcatRemoveFix: Disable mod-provided relics and potions when no Slugcat character is playing.
